title: Grafana: dashboards, data sources and annotations

videos.script: Grafana is where most people meet observability, and it is the part that stores the least. Not one number of yours lives in it. {{nothing}} It asks Prometheus, Loki and Jaeger, and draws what they answer. In this lesson you do everything through its API, the way automation does. {{api}} You list its data sources, and ask Prometheus a question through it. You create an account for a robot, with only the rights it needs, and watch it get refused the rest. {{robot}} You write a dashboard as a file, so it lives in version control and nobody edits it by hand. Then a deploy goes out and makes checkouts slow. You mark it on the dashboard, and roll it back. {{deploy}} And the graph shows you something uncomfortable. It noticed both events a minute late. {{late}}
